title: PlatformCosmoSpec
description: PlatformCosmo spec, format major version 1. Draft until v1.0.

$schema.description: Schema URL that editors use for completion, normally https://platformcosmo.io/schema/v1.json.

version.description: Spec format major version, always the string "1".

title.description: Short title of the spec, used as the SVG title element.

description.description: Longer description of the spec, used as the SVG desc element.

meta.description: Spec metadata: format version, title and description.

theme.description: Color theme for the diagram: light, dark, blueprint or mono.

grid.description: Whether to draw the iso ground grid behind the diagram (on by default; set false for a plain background).

padding.description: Empty space around the diagram in pixels, from 0 to 1000.

aspect.description: Output aspect ratio: "auto" or "width:height" such as 16:9.

canvas.description: Canvas appearance: theme, background grid, padding and aspect ratio.

nodes.description: Components to draw, each with a semantic type and an optional icon.

groups.description: Zones, VPCs, clusters or platforms that group nodes, optionally nested.

edges.description: Connections between objects (nodes, racks, equipment, or rackId/slotId).

flows.description: Animated flows of traffic or power along an edge, a cable or a pair of endpoints.

metrics.description: Headline metric tiles shown with the diagram.

steps.description: Animation steps, each with a caption, state changes, flows, metrics and a focus target.

label.description: Text shown for the legend entry.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name.

legend.description: Legend mode: "auto" to derive entries from the diagram, or a manual list of label and color pairs.

racks.description: Equipment racks, each with a height in rack units and optional slots.

equipment.description: Data-center equipment items (UPS, CRAH, CDU and similar) placed on the floor.

rows.description: Ordered rows of racks or equipment on the floor, with a facing direction.

aisles.description: Cold or hot aisles, each grouping rows of racks.

cables.description: DC cables (power, network, fiber or management) between racks, slots and equipment.

facility.description: Facility-wide settings: raised floor, perforated tiles and cable trays.

assemblies.description: Component-driven units (an engine, a server, a brick model) built from parts, with programmable explode and build programs (schema 1.2.0).

images.description: Images that parts and storyboards use: local files next to the spec or inline base64 data, never URLs (schema 1.2.0).

storyboards.description: Flat build storyboards made from a document's own step renders and part thumbnails; build forward and back only, no explode (schema 1.2.0).

figures.description: Document figures animated in their own drawn plane: cut-out sprites move between the drawn exploded and seated positions (schema 1.2.0).

color.title: SpecColor
color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name. Flow kind names: normal, heavy, health, failed, airflow, power.

id.description: Unique identifier of the node, used by edges, flows and steps.

type.description: Semantic component type, such as lb, sql or queue.

icon.description: Icon name to draw, such as aws:rds, which must be installed.

label.description: Text label shown for the node.

badge.description: Short badge text shown on the node.

size.description: Node size: sm, md or lg.

pos.description: Optional manual grid position that overrides automatic layout.

group.description: Id of the group that contains the node.

state.description: Initial operational state of the node: healthy, degraded, down or highlighted.

label.description: Text label shown for the group.

style.description: Visual style of the group: zone, vpc, cluster or platform.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing group, used for nesting.

id.description: Optional unique identifier of the edge, used to reference it from flows.

from.description: Source endpoint of the edge, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

to.description: Destination endpoint of the edge, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

label.description: Text label shown on the edge.

style.description: Line style of the edge: solid, dashed or dotted.

bidirectional.description: Whether the edge is drawn as two-way rather than one-way.

edge.description: Id of the edge or cable that the flow travels along.

kind.description: Flow kind that sets the default look: normal, heavy, health, failed, airflow or power.

rate.description: Particles emitted per second (0 < rate <= 20). Each flow costs ceil(rate x 2) particles; the total over base and all step flows must be <= 2000.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name.

from.description: Source endpoint of the flow, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

to.description: Destination endpoint of the flow, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

kind.description: Flow kind that sets the default look: normal, heavy, health, failed, airflow or power.

rate.description: Particles emitted per second (0 < rate <= 20). Each flow costs ceil(rate x 2) particles; the total over base and all step flows must be <= 2000.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name (blue, green, red, orange, yellow, purple, teal, pink, gray) or a flow kind name.

id.description: Unique identifier of the metric tile.

label.description: Text label shown on the metric tile.

value.description: Value shown on the metric tile, as text or a number.

caption.description: Text caption shown while the step plays.

set.description: State changes from this step onward (cumulative), keyed by object id, rackId/slotId or an assembly part path (assemblyId/partId/...).

flows.description: If present (even []), replaces the base flows for this step only; omit to keep the base flows.

metrics.description: Metric values from this step onward (cumulative), keyed by metric id.

duration.description: Step length in seconds at speed 1 (> 0, <= 600).

focus.description: Id to zoom to for this step only (object, rackId/slotId, group, row, aisle, assembly, assembly part path or storyboard); omit for the full view. An assembly target frames its pose at the end of the step.

assembly.description: Explode, implode, build or unbuild actions played in this step, in order (each starts when the previous one ends unless it sets start). Poses are cumulative across steps.

label.description: Text label shown for the rack.

u.description: Rack height in rack units: 42, 45 or 48.

pos.description: Optional manual grid position that overrides automatic placement.

pdu.description: PDU redundancy for the rack: none, single or dual.

rearDoorHeatExchanger.description: Whether the rack has a rear-door heat exchanger.

slots.description: Devices placed in the rack's rack units.

programs.description: Explode programs for the rack as an assembly (explode only; no build programs). Selectors are relative to the rack: slot ids, type:<slot type>, frame/<part> and frame/role:cover. Without one the rack has the built-in drawers program (doors, then every slot). Schema 1.2.0.

at.description: Lowest rack unit the device occupies (1 = bottom).

size.description: Rack units; defaults to the device type height.

type.description: Device type placed in the slot, such as server-1u or switch-tor.

label.description: Text label shown for the device in the slot.

state.description: Device state. Omit to inherit the rack state.

assembly.description: Id of a template assembly (template: true) that is the device's internals; the device gets a removable lid and the template is placed inside at true scale (schema 1.2.0).

closeup.description: Assembly (template), figure or storyboard shown as a close-up level when a step focuses this node's close-up. Address the close-up instance explicitly with the reserved path segment closeup (r2/srv/closeup, r2/srv/closeup/board/cpu-1); the coarse node keeps its own path.

id.description: Unique identifier of the equipment item.

type.description: Kind of data-center equipment, such as ups, crah or cdu.

label.description: Text label shown for the equipment item.

pos.description: Optional manual grid position that overrides automatic placement.

state.description: Operational state of the equipment item.

label.description: Text label shown for the row.

members.description: Ids of the racks or equipment items in the row, in order.

facing.description: Which side of the rack faces the row front. Omit to derive it from the aisles: rows face their cold aisle and turn their backs to their hot aisle.

label.description: Text label shown for the aisle.

kind.description: Whether the aisle is a cold aisle or a hot aisle.

rows.description: The one or two rows bounding the aisle.

contained.description: Whether the aisle is enclosed by doors or containment.

from.description: Source endpoint of the cable, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

to.description: Destination endpoint of the cable, as an object id or a rackId/slotId pair.

kind.description: Cable type: power, network, fiber or management.

label.description: Text label shown on the cable.

endpoint.title: SpecEndpoint
endpoint.description: An object id, or rackId/slotId for a device in a rack slot.

raisedFloor.description: Whether the room has a raised floor.

perforatedTiles.description: Whether the raised floor uses perforated airflow tiles.

cableTrays.description: Where cable trays run: none, overhead or underfloor.

partPath.title: SpecPartPath
partPath.description: An id, or up to 8 ids joined by / that address a rack slot (rackId/slotId), an assembly part (assemblyId/partId/...) or a close-up instance through the reserved segment closeup (rackId/slotId/closeup/partId).

vec3.title: SpecVec3
vec3.description: [x, y, z] in the assembly's units: x runs to the lower right of the screen, y to the lower left, z up.

size3.title: SpecSize3
size3.description: [width along x, depth along y, height along z] in the assembly's units, each > 0.

pixelRect.title: SpecPixelRect
pixelRect.description: [x, y, width, height] in image pixels (SVG images: viewBox units), from the top-left corner.

direction.title: SpecDirection
direction.description: Where a part travels. Presets: away (from the surface it mates with; the default), up, down, +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z (axes of the assembly frame), out (away from the parent's centre, snapped to the nearest horizontal axis), radial (away from the parent's centre in the horizontal plane, not snapped), axis (along the part's own cylinder or shaft axis, away from the parent's centre), drawer (toward the assembly front, like a rack device sliding out) and lift (up, stacked in layers so every layer clears the one below). Or an explicit [x, y, z] vector.

distance.title: SpecDistance
distance.description: How far a part travels: a number in the assembly's units, "auto" (clear its seat and every part it stacks with, plus the program gap) or a multiple of the auto distance such as "1.5x".

easing.title: SpecEasing
easing.description: Motion easing. All are monotonic (no overshoot), so a part never leaves the segment between its two poses.

selector.title: SpecPartSelector
selector.description: Selects nodes of the program owner (the assembly or sub-assembly that owns the program). A bare term matches the owner's direct children only: an id glob (cyl-*, dimm-?), or tag:<tag>, type:<type>, role:<role>. Prefix path segments to scope deeper: head/valve-* (children of head), **/type:dimm (any depth), frame/role:cover. * matches within one segment, ** any number of segments, ? one character. A selected sub-assembly moves as one unit.

source.title: SpecSource
source.description: Provenance of an image or a part taken from a document. Shown in the credits line when attribution or license is set; never fetched, never a link.

document.description: Document title or file name the content was taken from.

figure.description: Figure, table or step reference inside the page.

license.description: License of the source content, an SPDX id such as CC-BY-4.0 or free text.

attribution.description: Attribution text the license requires, shown in the credits line.

url.description: Where the document is published; printed as text in the credits, never fetched.

image.title: SpecImage
image.description: An image asset. src is a file path relative to the spec's directory (no .., no absolute paths, no URLs) or an inline data:image/(png|jpeg|svg+xml);base64 URI. PNG, JPEG and SVG only (WebP is rejected: convert it to PNG or JPEG). Formats are checked by magic bytes; metadata is dropped (a JPEG's EXIF orientation is applied as a transform first); SVG goes through the icon sanitizer.

id.description: Unique image id that parts and storyboards reference.

src.description: Relative file path (png, jpg, jpeg, svg) or an inline base64 data URI of up to about 256 KiB.

crop.description: Part of the image to use, applied as an SVG viewport (the full file is embedded; use pcosmo assets crop to cut the file itself).

alt.description: Short description used in the SVG desc and the credits line.

source.description: Document provenance and license of the image.

partImage.title: SpecPartImage
partImage.description: An image on a part: an image id (shown as an upright billboard), or an object with face, crop and fit.

ref.description: Id of an entry in images.

face.description: billboard: upright and never skewed, scaled to the part's screen silhouette; top, left (+y) or right (+x): a decal mapped onto that face of the part's box.

crop.description: Overrides the image's crop for this part.

fit.description: How the image fills its face or silhouette.

delay.description: Extra seconds before this part starts, at speed 1.

order.description: Rank in the stage's stagger order (lower moves first); ties keep the stage order.

stage.title: SpecStage
stage.description: One stage of an explode program: which parts move, where, how far and when.

label.description: Stage name, used in captions written by the skill and in diagnostics.

direction.description: Travel direction for every selected part.

distance.description: Travel distance for every selected part.

order.description: Stagger order: spec order, by distance from the assembly centre, by height, or by nearness to the viewer.

stagger.description: Seconds between the starts of consecutive parts, at speed 1.

delay.description: Seconds before the stage starts, at speed 1.

duration.description: Seconds each part travels, at speed 1.

with.description: after: start when the previous stage ends; previous: start together with it.

labels.description: Show each moved part's label (with a leader line) once it arrives.

leaders.description: Draw leader lines from labels to their parts.

details.description: Also show each part's detail lines under its label.

fade.description: Dim parts this stage does not move (unselected) or everything outside the assembly (others) while the stage is shown.

overrides.description: Per-part direction, distance, delay or order, keyed by part path relative to the program owner.

buildStep.title: SpecBuildStep
buildStep.description: One build step: parts appear at an origin and travel to their seats.

number.description: Step number printed in the document (booklet step), shown in the caption and the parts callout.

from.description: Where added parts come from: above their seat, the parts callout (fly from the callout box, then drop), outside the model bounds along their nearest free side, an axis, or an explicit vector.

distance.description: Travel distance from the origin to the seat.

subBuild.description: Sub-assembly (part path) built first at a staging spot beside the model by its own build program, then attached as one unit.

program.description: Build program of the sub-assembly to play for subBuild; default its first build program.

view.description: Rotate the view about the vertical axis (degrees, quarter turns only) from this step on, like a booklet's rotate-model hint. Assembly-only specs.

callout.description: Show the parts callout (count x part thumbnail) for this step.

duration.description: Seconds each part travels, at speed 1.

stagger.description: Seconds between consecutive parts, at speed 1.

program.title: SpecProgram
program.description: An explode program (ordered stages) or a build program (ordered build steps).

part.title: SpecPart
part.description: A part of an assembly: a primitive or pack shape, optionally image-fed, or a sub-assembly with its own parts.

id.description: Unique among its siblings; the part's path is the ids from the assembly down, joined by /.

label.description: Name shown when the part is exploded.

detail.description: Detail lines shown under the label when a stage enables details.

type.description: Free part type such as cpu, dimm, piston or valve, used by type: selectors, callouts and the suggestion heuristics.

role.description: Structural role used by the suggestion heuristics: body (never moves by default), cover (lids, panels), fastener, internal, cable or shell (open container).

shape.description: Primitive (box, plate, cylinder, ring, shaft, stud, prism, wedge, tray, card, sprite) or a pack shape such as dc:server-2u, hw:dimm, auto:piston, brick:brick. Ignored for sub-assemblies.

at.description: Minimum corner of the part's (rotated) box in its parent's frame; default [0, 0, 0].

size.description: Extent of the unrotated part; pack shapes have a default size, sub-assemblies default to their parts' bounds.

axis.description: Axis of a cylinder, ring or shaft.

rotate.description: Quarter-turn rotation about the vertical axis (degrees); 90 and 270 swap width and depth.

params.description: Shape parameters for a pack shape (for example studs or hollow for brick shapes).

tone.description: Theme material of a primitive part.

color.description: #rgb or #rrggbb hex, a palette name or a flow kind name; overrides tone.

image.description: Image shown on the part (billboard or face decal).

state.description: Initial state; omit to inherit the parent's.

count.description: Repeat the part count times; when count is above 1 copies get ids <id>-1 ... <id>-n (count 1 keeps the id) and are offset by pitch.

pitch.description: Offset between repeated copies, in the parent's units.

mates.description: Sibling part (path relative to the parent) this part sits on or in; the away direction leaves its contact face. Inferred from contact when omitted.

inserts.description: Solid sibling (path relative to the parent) this part is inserted into, such as a valve through a head or a bolt in a block: the part's inside portion is clipped at that solid's entry face instead of counting as a collision. Detected automatically when unambiguous.

closeup.description: Assembly (template), figure or storyboard shown as a close-up level when a step focuses this node's close-up. Address the close-up instance explicitly with the reserved path segment closeup (r2/srv/closeup, r2/srv/closeup/board/cpu-1); the coarse node keeps its own path.

use.description: Template assembly instanced as this part's sub-assembly, scaled to size when size is set.

parts.description: Child parts: makes this part a sub-assembly that moves as one unit unless a selector picks its children.

programs.description: Programs of this sub-assembly; selectors are relative to it.

source.description: Document provenance of the part (dimensions, figure).

assembly.title: SpecAssembly
assembly.description: A component-driven unit drawn assembled in isometric view, with explode and build programs.

id.description: Unique id (shares the namespace with nodes, racks and the rest).

label.description: Name of the unit.

units.description: Units of at, size, pitch and distances: mm, cm, in, tile (one world grid tile) or stud (x and y in 8 mm studs, z in 3.2 mm plates; a brick is 3 plates).

fit.description: Scale so the assembled unit's largest horizontal extent is this many grid tiles; ignored for units tile and inside a rack slot.

front.description: Side of the unit that is its front (the drawer direction). +y faces the viewer's lower left, +x the lower right.

rotate.description: Quarter-turn rotation of the whole unit about the vertical axis.

pos.description: Optional manual grid position that overrides automatic layout.

group.description: Id of the group that contains the unit.

state.description: Initial state of every part that does not set its own.

labels.description: exploded: part labels appear (with leader lines) when stages show them; always: also print each leaf's label upright on its top face at rest (plans, board layouts); never: no part labels.

pose.description: Base pose, shown in the static output, the poster frame and at the start of the loop: assembled, exploded (default program, all stages) or empty (only parts no build step adds).

program.description: Default program for actions that do not name one; default the first explode program, else the first build program.

closeup.description: Assembly (template), figure or storyboard shown as a close-up level when a step focuses this node's close-up. Address the close-up instance explicitly with the reserved path segment closeup (r2/srv/closeup, r2/srv/closeup/board/cpu-1); the coarse node keeps its own path.

template.description: Not drawn by itself; instanced by parts[].use, racks[].slots[].assembly or closeup.

parts.description: Top-level parts (at most 2000 leaf parts per spec after count and use are expanded).

programs.description: Explode and build programs; when there is none the skill or pcosmo suggest one.

source.description: Document the unit was modelled from.

assemblyAction.title: SpecAssemblyAction
assemblyAction.description: A pose change of an assembly, sub-assembly, rack or storyboard in a step.

explode.description: Assembly, sub-assembly path, rack id, rackId/slotId or figure to explode.

program.description: Explode program; default the target's default program.

to.description: Stage to reach (partial explode); default the last stage.

start.description: Seconds after the step's motion window opens, at speed 1; default right after the previous action.

implode.description: Assembly, sub-assembly path, rack id, rackId/slotId or figure to implode.

program.description: Explode program to reverse; default the one that exploded it.

start.description: Seconds after the step's motion window opens, at speed 1.

program.description: Build program; default the target's program when it is a build program, else its first build program.

to.description: Build step (or storyboard frame) to reach; default: advance by one step (see advance).

advance.description: Build this many more steps instead of naming to; default 1 when neither is set.

start.description: Seconds after the step's motion window opens, at speed 1.

unbuild.description: Assembly or storyboard to take apart in reverse build order.

to.description: Build step to return to; default 0 (empty).

start.description: Seconds after the step's motion window opens, at speed 1.

storyboardItem.title: SpecStoryboardItem
storyboardItem.description: A part thumbnail in a storyboard callout.

count.description: How many of this part the step uses, shown as <count>x.

label.description: Optional part name.

storyboardFrame.title: SpecStoryboardFrame
storyboardFrame.description: One document step: the model render after the step, the parts callout and an optional sub-build.

number.description: Step number printed in the document.

model.description: Image of the model after this step.

attach.description: [x, y] in percent of the model image where the step's parts land; default the centre.

sub.description: Sub-build mini-step images in order (count unused); the last one docks at attach before the model image changes.

storyboard.title: SpecStoryboard
storyboard.description: A flat, faithful build sequence made from a document's own step renders and part thumbnails (tier A of document ingestion).

label.description: Name of the model.

width.description: Width of the storyboard panel in grid tiles.

transition.description: How the model image changes between steps.

source.description: The document; required in practice for credits.

figurePart.title: SpecFigurePart
figurePart.description: A part sprite cut out of a figure, with its seated and exploded positions in the figure's pixel frame.

label.description: Name shown when the part is exploded.

detail.description: Detail lines shown under the label when a stage enables details.

type.description: Free part type for type: selectors.

image.description: The part's cut-out sprite (transparent outside its silhouette).

seat.description: [x, y] of the sprite's top-left corner in the base image's pixels when seated (from pcosmo assets locate).

exploded.description: [x, y] of the sprite's top-left corner when exploded; default straight up by the sprite height plus 20%.

z.description: Draw-order override; default by the seat's bottom edge (lower on screen draws later).

arrow.description: Draw a fading motion arrow between seat and exploded position.

source.description: Where the sprite was cut from.

figureStage.title: SpecFigureStage
figureStage.description: A stage of a figure: which sprites move and when (motion is between the drawn seat and exploded positions).

label.description: Stage name.

stagger.description: Seconds between consecutive parts, at speed 1.

delay.description: Seconds before the stage starts, at speed 1.

duration.description: Seconds each part travels, at speed 1.

labels.description: Show labels with leader lines once parts arrive.

figure.title: SpecFigure
figure.description: Figure mode: a document figure (exploded and/or assembled drawing) animated in its own drawn plane by moving cut-out sprites; no 3D inference.

label.description: Name of the figure.

width.description: Width of the figure panel in grid tiles.

base.description: Image of the figure with every moving part erased (pcosmo assets cutout --erase-from) and arrows removed.

pose.description: Base pose shown in the static output and at the start of the loop. A figure drawn exploded usually sets exploded, so its first action implodes it.

stages.description: Stages; default one stage moving every part in spec order.

source.description: The document and page of the figure.

x.description: Horizontal grid tile coordinate, from -1000 to 1000.

y.description: Vertical grid tile coordinate, from -1000 to 1000.

id.description: Program id, unique within its assembly or sub-assembly.

label.description: Program name.

gap.description: Clearance between parts after an auto-distance move, in the assembly's units; default 10% of the assembly's largest extent.

stages.description: Stages in order; explode to stage k plays stages 1..k, implode plays them backwards.

id.description: Program id, unique within its assembly or sub-assembly.

label.description: Program name.

steps.description: Build steps in order; parts not added by any step are the base and are present from the start.
